title: Maria's Active Day
text:
Maria likes sports. Every morning she runs in the park. She jumps over small logs and climbs the hill. After that, she swims at the pool.

Today Maria is at school. She writes a story in her notebook. Her friend Tom reads it and smiles. Then they kick a ball outside.

questions.text: Where does Maria run every morning?
What does Maria write in her notebook?
How does Tom probably feel when he reads Maria's story?
What kind of person is Maria most likely?

vocabulary.definition: shows a happy face with the mouth turned up

paragraph_translations: A María le gustan los deportes. Cada mañana corre en el parque. Salta sobre troncos pequeños y sube la colina. Después, nada en la piscina.
Hoy María está en la escuela. Escribe una historia en su cuaderno. Su amigo Tom la lee y sonríe. Luego patean una pelota afuera.
